themes.name: Velvet Downbeat
themes.description: A late-night jazz hall rendered in tarnished brass and oxblood, where cinematic imagery breathes through deep shadow and warm ivory type.

props.text: The last set ends at 2am. Brass catches the light. Everything else is shadow.
A late-night jazz hall in tarnished brass and oxblood.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Brazilian modernist terrace frozen at peak afternoon — generous type carved into warm shade, turquoise water glimpsed through deep green eaves.

props.text: A terrace at two in the afternoon. The overhang swallows the sun, but turquoise still seeps through. Type carved wide and generous, the way concrete remembers touch.

themes.name: Wet Circuit
themes.description: The sharp geometry of urban signage meeting rain-slick stillness — dense technical precision breathing inside generous negative space.

props.text: Rain-slick geometry. Technical precision inside generous silence. Every edge is a signal.

themes.name: Peach Frequency
themes.description: A rhythm-led composition where generous breathing room and dense typographic detail alternate like measures in an early-morning song.

props.text: Breathe in. Type densely. Breathe out. Like bars in an early-morning song, this theme alternates silence and weight until the whole day feels composed.
generous breathing room and dense typographic detail
Bricolage Grotesque × Lora — early-morning rhythm, vivid image glow, boxed footer.

themes.name: Fountain & Rule
themes.description: A late-night riad courtyard rendered as a technical index — cobalt geometry meeting bone-white silence, dense annotation beside generous shadow.

props.text: A riad at midnight, indexed. Cobalt geometry cuts through bone-white silence — shadow is the margin, annotation is the ornament.

themes.name: Chrome Oasis
themes.description: Palm Springs architecture glimpsed through a CRT monitor at midnight — swimming-pool turquoise against deep desert navy, rendered in high-gloss detail with generous breathing room between each image.

props.text: A CRT blinks on at midnight. Palm Springs concrete glows turquoise in the cathode light. High-gloss stillness. Desert air, pool-cold.
Swimming-pool turquoise. Midnight architecture. High gloss, wide breath.

themes.name: Azulejo Evening
themes.description: Cobalt geometry meets warm tin-glazed parchment — a Portuguese tile wall catching the last golden hour, rendered as a measured editorial journal.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A tile wall at dusk. Cobalt geometry pressed into warm parchment — the geometry of prayer, the patience of craft, the last raking light before evening.
